name: Kuraki Mizuna
source: Yuriko's first daughter and Suzuna's monozygotic twin sister. Unlike her younger sister, Mizuna is very taciturn, but cheerfully playful; living silently and peacefully in the water caverns beneath the mansion. For unknown reasons, she appears unable to speak.
